LEONI is a global provider of products, solutions, and services for power distribution and connectivity in the automotive industry. The Group employs approximately 95,000 people across 23 countries and generated consolidated sales of approximately EUR 3.9 billion in 2025, excluding the former Automotive Cable Solutions division.
With a 74.9% ownership stake in LEONI, LUXSHARE is both the company’s majority shareholder and a strategic partner, actively supporting and enabling LEONI’s long-term growth and success while contributing to its strategic direction.
LEONI’s customer base spans leading global automotive OEMs, commercial vehicle manufacturers, and component suppliers.
Join us and help drive the transformation of the automotive world
 Job Description
 Shape the future of enterprise applications with modern .NET technologies. As an Expert .NET Software Developer, you will design, develop, and optimize scalable software solutions while leveraging AI-powered development tools to enhance coding efficiency, quality, and innovation. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will contribute to the full software development lifecycle, applying best practices, modern architectures, and clean coding principles to deliver reliable business solutions.
Develop software applications according to specifications and project requirements. 
Propose and define efficient, scalable technical solutions. 
Use AI-driven tools to optimize coding, debugging, and testing
Maintain, optimize, and enhance existing applications. 
Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to deliver project objectives. 
Apply coding standards and best practices to ensure clean, modular, and well‑structured code. 
 Qualifications
University degree in IT or a technical field. 
Professional experience with .NET and C#. 
Strong knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server / T-SQL. 
Experience with version control systems such as Git
Experience using Azure DevOps—pipelines, repositories, and boards
Effective use of AI-powered coding assistants and tools
Solid understanding of object‑oriented programming (OOP) concepts. 
Fluent English. 
Experience with the Angular framework is considered an advantage
Teamwork skills, good communication, and a solution‑oriented mindset.
